title: cMini: Continuum's own Pokémon Mini emulator
default: PokeMini remains first and default; cMini is second.

items.title: Settings inventory
items.result: PMINI_OPTIONS_INVENTORY.md records PokeMini's 13 settings and cMini's two hardware-backed additions.

items.title: MINX and machine
items.result: Rewritten on 29 October 2026 to follow PokeMini part for part: MINX (all opcodes and cycles), interrupt controller, timers (both oscillators, 8/16-bit, pivot), PRC (855-cycle steps, stall, rate), LCD controller and panel (contrast levels, analog fading), buttons, shock, battery, I/O port, save chip protocol, motor, direct-PWM sound with the piezo model.

items.title: Libretro behavior
items.result: Video, audio, input, options, 8192-byte PokeMini-compatible save RAM, tagged states, achievements memory and real/direct BIOS starts.

items.title: Reference proof against PokeMini
items.result: tests/console_pokemini.rs runs PokeMini itself next to cMini: every instruction and every frame (registers, RAM, I/O, LCD, shades, sound samples, pixels) agree over PokeMini's 5 example programs and 24 random programs (300,000 instructions, 1,200 frames each); planted bugs are caught. tests/cpu_pokemini.rs: 42,768 of 42,768 random instruction states. tests/libretro.rs: frames, sound, memory sizes, states, reset, 60 Hz.

items.title: App and build integration
items.result: Optional unpinned Cargo core, cache checker coverage, Xcode embed, CI-name exemption, CoreCatalog descriptor and second Pokémon Mini choice.

items.title: cMini's own start-up program
items.result: src/bios.rs, written for cMini: hands the game exactly PokeMini's free program's state and answers its services the same (tested against it); the old stand-in sent every interrupt to the wrong place.

items.title: Libretro behaviour as PokeMini's core
items.result: 8 KiB system RAM in PokeMini's layout, the game's LCD contrast in the picture, 60 Hz as six frames to five, PokeMini's turbo, shake and rumble, the clock from local time at start, reset and state load, states without the cartridge (format 2).

items.title: Phone proof
items.result: Needs the later single batch iPhone build with cAtari; PokeMini stays default meanwhile.

limitations: No iOS SDK is available locally; phone behaviour is not marked Done.
Commercial games and a commercial bios.min were not obtained or used.
Power-off save on close and a two-phone infrared transport are not there (see POKEMON_MINI_CORE.md, Known gaps).
